import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.preprocessing import LabelEncoder
from sklearn.metrics import log_loss
import xgboost as xgb
import warnings
import os

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

# Check data paths
print(os.listdir("./input"))

# Load data with correct column names
train_df = pd.read_csv("./input/train.csv")
test_df = pd.read_csv("./input/test.csv")
sample_sub = pd.read_csv("./input/sample_submission.csv")

# Verify feature columns (data overview shows margin1, not margin_1)
feature_cols = [col for col in train_df.columns if col not in ["id", "species"]]
print(f"Number of features: {len(feature_cols)}")

X = train_df[feature_cols].values
y = train_df["species"].values
X_test = test_df[feature_cols].values

# Encode target
label_encoder = LabelEncoder()
y_encoded = label_encoder.fit_transform(y)

# Split for validation (preserve stratification)
X_train, X_val, y_train, y_val = train_test_split(
    X, y_encoded, test_size=0.2, stratify=y_encoded, random_state=42
)

# Define XGBoost parameters
params = {
    "objective": "multi:softprob",
    "num_class": len(np.unique(y_encoded)),
    "max_depth": 7,
    "learning_rate": 0.03,
    "subsample": 0.8,
    "colsample_bytree": 0.8,
    "min_child_weight": 3,
    "gamma": 0.1,
    "reg_alpha": 0.1,
    "reg_lambda": 1.0,
    "random_state": 42,
    "verbosity": 0,
    "n_estimators": 500,
}

# Train XGBoost model
dtrain = xgb.DMatrix(X_train, label=y_train)
dval = xgb.DMatrix(X_val, label=y_val)
evals_result = {}

model = xgb.train(
    params,
    dtrain,
    num_boost_round=1000,
    evals=[(dtrain, "train"), (dval, "val")],
    early_stopping_rounds=50,
    evals_result=evals_result,
    verbose_eval=False,
)

# Predict on validation set
val_proba = model.predict(dval)
val_logloss = log_loss(y_val, val_proba)
print(f"Validation Log Loss: {val_logloss:.6f}")

# Train final model on full training data (no calibration for speed)
dfull = xgb.DMatrix(X, label=y_encoded)
final_model = xgb.train(params, dfull, num_boost_round=500, verbose_eval=False)

# Predict on test set
dtest = xgb.DMatrix(X_test)
test_proba = final_model.predict(dtest)

# Prepare submission file
class_names = label_encoder.classes_
submission_df = pd.DataFrame(test_proba, columns=class_names)
submission_df.insert(0, "id", test_df["id"])

# Ensure submission directory exists
os.makedirs("./submission", exist_ok=True)

# Save submission
submission_df.to_csv("./submission/submission.csv", index=False)
print("Submission file saved!")
